answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Rounds. Each epoch, an identity must answer a private challenge derived from its own interaction history, which no clone can predict before acting. A clone that behaves identically inherits identical history, so it cannot diverge without spending a fresh meadow of distinct actions to seed a separate trajectory. The vault of accumulated responses then mismatches across copies, exposing them. The lotus of valid answers per identity stays unique. Cost: each sybil must replay and alter a full independent history, multiplying attacker work linearly per copy.
